- [ ] `grep -c gt_evdev_code_sdl_index assets/gt-input-remap.c` -> 0

tasks.subject: Task 5: Shim analog-to-key synthesis, gptokeyb parity (F53)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** On stick-class devices with a gptk loaded, stick deflections synthesize the gptk's `left_analog_*`/`right_analog_*` keys (gptokeyb defaults when unnamed; `deadzone` 1..32767 honored, default 15000; mouse sticks skipped), edge-tracked via `gt_evdev_hat_edges`, first key replacing the axis event, rest stashed, mirrored into the polled keystate. Plan Task 5 has all the C. Spec §4.4.

**Files:**
- Modify: `assets/gt-input-remap.c` (gt_keyname home 74/end 77; gt_keymap += analog_key[2][4], analog_mouse[2], deadzone; gt_keymap_defaults, gt_analog_name (after gt_dir_slot), gt_axis_dir, gt_axis_slots (after gt_evdev_hat_edges); gt_gptk_line analog + deadzone branches; gt_init calls gt_keymap_defaults before parsing; static int gt_axis_prev[4]; SDL_JOYAXISMOTION branch in gt_rewrite after the hat branch; test main updates)
- Rebuild: `assets/gt-input-remap.so`, `assets/gt-input-remap.armhf.so`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] host test `remap ok`: home/end; defaults left w/s/a/d, right end/home/left/right, deadzone 15000, defaults alone don't set loaded; present line overrides; `\"` and unknown clear; mouse_movement_* sets analog_mouse + clears; deadzone 1/32767/20000 accepted, 0/99999/abc rejected; deadzone_x and _repeat ignored; gt_axis_dir at 14999/15000/-15000/27935/-32768/0 and dz=1; gt_axis_slots axes 0-3; center->up->down->center edges
- [ ] gt_rewrite axis branch gated on gt_map.loaded && gt_sticks_class && axis < 4; mouse stick passes through; first key replaces / rest stashed; debug line on direction change
- [ ] both .so rebuilt, arch verified; `make test` green

**Verify:** `cc -DGT_REMAP_TEST -O2 -Wall -o /tmp/remap-test assets/gt-input-remap.c && /tmp/remap-test` -> `remap ok`; `make test` -> `ALL TESTS PASSED`; `file` both .so
